profile.headline: Information Technology Software Engineer at U.S. Department of the Treasury
profile.summary:
Always in learning mode. I have completed a Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity with a concentration in Digital Forensics, with hands-on experience from extensive cybersecurity and DFIR-focused labs. I am a software engineer experienced in building Python-based automations and Microsoft Power Platform solutions in enterprise environments. I also hold a B.A.S. in Operations Management and Supervision from Miami Dade College, combining technical execution with operational and business awareness.

Technical Skills:
Cybersecurity & Forensics: Network traffic analysis (Wireshark), IDS monitoring (Snort), disk imaging and forensic analysis (FTK Imager, Magnet AXIOM), log analysis, vulnerability assessment labs.
Programming & Automation: Python, REST APIs, Object-Oriented Programming, Git
Microsoft Power Platform & Data: Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power BI
Web & Systems: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Linux
